specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.7.0 rules remain active. This version only resolves the conflicts between v2.7.0 and the v2.3.0-v2.5.0 companion rules that v2.7.0 left active, and records the decisions of 2026-11-13.

specification.description: v2.7.1 overlay: applies the v2.7.0 companion identity and visible-name rules (NAME-003, PASSENGER-IDENTITY-002) to the field rules, passenger catalog, validations and test expectations that still described the v2.3.0 convention.

changes: field_rules.client_name follows NAME-003: companion First Name ends with -PCA (PCA) or -COM (COM/COMP) exactly once; Last Name gets no suffix. Replaces the v2.3.0 COMPANION Last Name suffix still active in v2.7.0.
COMPANION-FIRSTNAME-CLEANUP-002: a trailing legacy - PCA or - COM in the manifest First Name is removed once before the v2.7.0 suffix is added.
COMPANION-LASTNAME-CLEANUP-001: a trailing COMPANION, PCA or COM in the manifest Last Name of a companion is removed once (decision 2026-11-13).
CATALOG-NAME-MIGRATION-003 replaces CATALOG-PCA-FIRSTNAME-MIGRATION-001 (v2.3.0), which would remove -PCA and add COMPANION again on every catalog upload.
Catalogs built before v2.7.0 are discarded; the catalog is regenerated from the original 2026-10-23 manifest (decision 2026-11-13).
VAL-005, VAL-009, consistency_contract and the expectations of AT-02, AT-25, AT-31 to AT-33 and TC-003, TC-005, TC-006, TC-015 updated to v2.7.0.

companion_definition.superseded_by: passenger_identity_v2_7 (PCA -> PCA, COM and COMP -> COM)

normalization.identity_component_policy: The same AlnumClientID normalization is used by Vendor ID, Leg ID, Tobi MRN, pairing groups and passenger-catalog key comparisons. For companion rows, remove one trailing legacy suffix of the same identity (PCA for PCA; COM for COM and COMP) before adding the canonical suffix of passenger_identity_v2_7.

components.AlnumClientID: Client ID with every character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9 removed. For companion rows, remove one trailing suffix of the same identity (PCA, or COM for COM/COMP) before composing the canonical suffix (technical_identity_v2_7).

client_name.catalog_override: For existing passengers, use catalog values after CATALOG-NAME-MIGRATION-003.

legacy_first_name_cleanup.when: Passenger Ty is PCA, COM or COMP
legacy_first_name_cleanup.action: Remove one trailing visible suffix (optional spaces + hyphen + optional spaces + PCA or COM), case-insensitive, before the NAME-003 suffix is added.
legacy_first_name_cleanup.do_not_remove: PCA or COM text that is not the trailing suffix

legacy_last_name_cleanup.when: Passenger Ty is PCA, COM or COMP
legacy_last_name_cleanup.action: Remove one trailing legacy Last Name suffix (COMPANION, PCA or COM), case-insensitive; these names are deprecated by NAME-003.

invalid_when: Last Name (text before the first comma) is empty; for companions, after COMPANION-LASTNAME-CLEANUP-001
First Name (text after the first comma) is empty; for companions, after COMPANION-FIRSTNAME-CLEANUP-002 and before the NAME-003 suffix is added

passenger_catalog.purpose: Avoid aliases in TOBI while enforcing the v2.7.0 naming convention: companion First Name ends with -PCA or -COM, Last Name has no suffix.

key.canonicalization: Remove non-alphanumeric characters and compare case-insensitively. PCA and COM are different identities: 82475PCA and 82475COM are different passengers.

passenger_catalog.existing_passenger: Output takes First Name, Last Name and Primary Phone from the catalog after CATALOG-NAME-MIGRATION-003.

new_passenger.action: Build values with field_rules and append one catalog row: First Name ends with -PCA or -COM for companions, Last Name has no suffix, MRN Number equals Tobi MRN, Telephone equals Primary Phone.

passenger_catalog.same_file: If a new passenger appears in several rows of the same Viajes file, the first normalized source row defines the catalog values.
passenger_catalog.companions: PCA and COM/COMP have separate catalog rows keyed by Tobi MRN (82475PCA: DEANNE-PCA / ALLOUCHE; 82475COM: DEANNE-COM / ALLOUCHE).
passenger_catalog.output_file: NCTD_Passengers_<YYYYMMDD>_UPDTD.csv: uploaded rows in original order after CATALOG-NAME-MIGRATION-003, followed by new passengers in source row order.

migration_rules.reason: The v2.3.0 migration removes a trailing -PCA and appends COMPANION, which would undo NAME-003 every time the previous day's catalog is uploaded.
migration_rules.scope: Catalog rows whose canonical MRN Number ends with PCA or COM
migration_rules.client_rows: Rows whose MRN does not end with PCA or COM are not changed.
migration_rules.assumption: NCTD Client ID values are numeric (confirmed 2026-11-11), so a MRN ending in PCA or COM always belongs to a companion.

catalog_reset.decision: Catalogs built with rules before v2.7.0 are discarded. The catalog is regenerated from the original 2026-10-23 manifest (NCTD_Trips_10.23.26_Source.xlsx) with these rules.

deprecated: Sequential 10-digit Trip ID for TOBI export
Leg ID format without pickup time

ASSISTANT_WITHOUT_CLIENT, MULTIPLE_CLIENTS_SAME_LEG, MULTIPLE_ASSISTANTS_SAME_LEG, MULTIPLE_RETURN_LEGS, MORE_THAN_TWO_LEGS, INVALID_LEG_SEQUENCE, LEG_B_BEFORE_LEG_A, JOURNEY_ASSIGNMENT_AMBIGUOUS, INVALID_JOURNEY_ID
Visible First Name suffix " - PCA" for companions
COMPANION, PCA or COM suffix in companion Last Name (v2.7.0)
PCA identity suffix for COM and COMP (v2.7.0)
Catalogs built with rules before v2.7.0

companion_visible_name_policy.First Name: Ends with -PCA (PCA) or -COM (COM, COMP) exactly once

consistency_contract.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-53 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0, v2.6.0, v2.7.0 and v2.7.1

deviations.TC-003: Expected First Name DEANNE-PCA and Last Name ALLOUCHE (v2.7.0 NAME-003).
deviations.TC-005: COM keeps its own identity: Tobi MRN 82475COM, Vendor ID ...COM, Leg ID ...COMA (v2.7.0).
deviations.TC-006: COMP canonicalizes to COM: Tobi MRN 82475COM, Vendor ID ...COM, Leg ID ...COMA (v2.7.0).
deviations.TC-015: Legacy ALLOUCHE COMPANION,DEANNE - PCA becomes Last Name ALLOUCHE and First Name DEANNE-PCA (v2.7.1).

validations_patch.assertion: PCA IDs end in PCA, PCAA or PCAB; COM and COMP IDs end in COM, COMA or COMB; never with _ or -.
Companion First Name ends with -PCA (PCA) or -COM (COM, COMP) exactly once; companion Last Name has no COMPANION, PCA or COM suffix.

acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Separate Vendor ID and Leg ID; companion Tobi MRN ends with PCA; First Name ends with -PCA; Last Name unchanged.
Own catalog row: First Name DEANNE-PCA, Last Name ALLOUCHE, MRN Number 82475PCA.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: New PCA, COM or COMP with Client Name ALLOUCHE,DEANNE
Catalog row in the old format (DEANNE - PCA or DEANNE / ALLOUCHE COMPANION, MRN 82475PCA)
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: CATALOG-NAME-MIGRATION-003: catalog and Output use First Name DEANNE-PCA and Last Name ALLOUCHE; MRN and phone unchanged.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Reprocess a catalog already in the v2.7.0 format
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: First Name and Last Name remain unchanged; no repeated -PCA or -COM.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Companion manifest name with legacy suffixes (ALLOUCHE COMPANION,DEANNE - PCA)
